version: 0.4.2
tagline: Clearer labels, a calmer world-boss card, and a trophy for your first kill on every boss.

## New
- 🏷️ **Clearer column labels:** DPS, DMG and DMG % each sit centred over their own number
- 🌐 **World Boss:** joining a busy world boss late no longer shows a ⚠ warning
- 🏆 **First record:** your first kill on a boss is celebrated too, and the 🏆 line now stays 10 minutes
